quote: This is twice as fast, because the two coroutines execute concurrently. Note that concurrency with coroutines is always explicit.
note: 官方頁面並排示範:順序呼叫 2017 ms、改用 async 並行 1017 ms,支持「互不依賴的呼叫要並行、否則耗時相加」。

quote: This function is not equivalent to `deferreds.map { it.await() }` which fails only when it sequentially gets to wait for the failing deferred, while this `awaitAll` fails immediately as soon as any of the deferreds fail.
note: awaitAll 頁面直接點名 map { await } 不等價、失敗要等輪到才發現,與型錄後果一致。joinAll 部分未另行核對。

quote: Reports function calls with the `Deferred` result type if the return value is not used.
note: JetBrains Inspectopedia 官方檢查說明支持壞寫法形狀;kotlinx 例外處理頁說 async 的例外要靠使用者 await 才會取得(relying on the user to consume the final exception),支持後果。Sonar S6315 頁面抓取 404,未採用。

quote: It propagates the cancellation in one direction only and cancels all its children only if it failed itself.
note: 頁面講 supervisorScope 單向傳遞、子失敗不連坐,並說 async 例外要在 await 處消費,支持標準寫法的選擇。coroutineScope 兄弟被取消只有範例註解隱含;runCatching 重拋 CancellationException 未在此頁核對。

quote: The default value is 0 which imposes no timeout.
note: OkHttp 官方原始碼 KDoc:callTimeout 為整個呼叫的預設逾時,預設 0 即無上限。引句不足 8 字以外的完整句為 'A value of 0 means no timeout, otherwise values must be between 1 and Integer.MAX_VALUE when converted to milliseconds.' 官方 5.x 文件頁當次抓取回 404,改用官方 GitHub 原始碼。

quote: When the original flow emits a new value, the previous flow produced by `transform` block is cancelled.
note: 支持 flatMapLatest 取消舊查詢的標準寫法。flatMapConcat/flatMapMerge 的排隊說法及 job?.cancel() 寫法未在此頁逐字核對。

查了 developer.android.com 的 UI events 頁:ViewModel 以 uiState(isLoginInProgress)呈現進行中並隱藏表單,但頁面沒有明講防重複送出或連點會重複扣款。搜尋 ViewModel double click prevent 只找到 Kotlin Slack 討論(不算權威)與一段未能在 ViewStub 頁抓到的 View 文件句子。找不到權威原文,維持 weak。

quote: Using awaitClose is mandatory in order to prevent memory leaks when the flow collection is cancelled, otherwise the callback may keep running even when the flow collector is already completed.
note: 同頁另有 'this method throws IllegalStateException if block returns, but the channel is not closed yet.',洩漏與例外後果都對上,範例也是 awaitClose { api.unregister(callback) }。

quote: Report usages of `Thread.sleep` in suspending functions and coroutine blocks.
note: detekt SleepInsteadOfDelay 官方規則頁,並說明會 halt the execution of unrelated coroutines。Call.execute/Future.get 的部分未在權威頁逐字核對(kotlinlang 教學頁只說 execute() 是 blocks the underlying thread 的同步呼叫)。

查了 kotlinx 組合頁(只講 lazy async 的 await 會變順序,沒講 eager async{}.await() 冗餘)、Inspectopedia 協程檢查頁(無 redundant async 項)、JetBrains blog(403)、inspectopedia RedundantAsyncCall(404)。只找到 kotlinx GitHub issue 與第三方鏡像提到 IDE 有此建議,不算權威。

quote: The deserialized response body of a {@linkplain #isSuccessful() successful} response.
note: Retrofit 官方原始碼 javadoc:body() 只定義為成功回應的本體,isSuccessful 為 code 在 [200..300)。只間接支持 4xx/5xx 時 body 為 null 而 !! 會 NPE;直接丟 HttpException 的說法未另核。

quote: OkHttp performs best when you create a single `OkHttpClient` instance and reuse it for all of your HTTP calls.
note: OkHttp 官方原始碼 KDoc 的首句。連線池與執行緒池各 client 自有、newBuilder 共用的敘述來自搜尋摘要,未逐字核對;洩漏後果屬推論。

quote: Many web sites describe a poor alternative solution, which is to install a TrustManager that does nothing.
note: 同頁說明這會讓使用者在公共 Wi-Fi 下受攻擊(中間人),並說 So don't do this, even temporarily。另註:同頁警告 SSLSocket does not perform hostname verification,且說憑證釘選 is not recommended for Android apps(但提供 Network Security Config 釘選),型錄建議釘選時宜加註風險,但不構成相反。

quote: Allowing cleartext network communications in an Android app means that anyone monitoring network traffic can see and manipulate the data that is being transmitted.
note: 官方頁建議用 NetworkSecurityConfig 關閉明文並只對特定網域例外,與標準寫法一致。注意:API 28 起 OkHttp 等預設已禁明文。
搜尋 coroutines deduplicate in-flight / single-flight:官方文件沒有此模式,只有 kotlinx.coroutines issue #2470、#1097 的功能請求(使用者提案,非權威指引)與第三方 Ktor 外掛、Slack 討論。找不到權威原文。

quote: The reason is that when coroutines finish with a CancellationException, the error does not get propagated to the parent, just like it doesn't when a child actually gets cancelled.
note: withTimeout 官方頁以 TimeoutCancellationException 被當成一般取消為例,並建議 withTimeoutOrNull(...) ?: error(...) 或 catch TimeoutCancellationException,與標準寫法一致。

quote: Kotlin coroutines api for timeouts should be used
note: Sonar 官方社群公告列出 S6316 規則標題;rules.sonarsource.com 頁面抓取皆 404,故只有標題原文,無法逐字確認壞寫法與後果('逾時不會取消底層工作' 未核)。withTimeout 頁另說 withTimeout 只取消區塊本身。證據偏薄但不相反。
搜尋 exception message string 與依型別判斷:developer.android.com 只有 UnknownHostException/SocketTimeoutException 型別本身的參考頁,沒有任何頁面說不該比對例外訊息字串。找不到權威原文。
